replays.purpose: Separate non-scoring seed-0 replay of unchanged invalid attempt 100. A worker wrapper records the number of starts returned after the new orientation filter. Instrumentation adds overhead. Official results are unchanged; the replay is excluded from counting and never supplied to Flint.
replays.worker_source:
"""Execute one candidate inside the OS sandbox; acceptance happens in the parent."""

import importlib.util
import json
import resource
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

cpu_seconds = int(sys.argv[1])
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (cpu_seconds, cpu_seconds))
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (2 * 1024 * 1024, 2 * 1024 * 1024))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate", "solver.py")
candidate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(candidate)

original_extra_starts = candidate._extra_starts
def observed_extra_starts(base):
    out = original_extra_starts(base)
    print(json.dumps({"event": "extra_starts_result", "returned_starts": len(out)}), flush=True)
    return out
candidate._extra_starts = observed_extra_starts

circles = candidate.solve(26, int(sys.argv[2]), max(0, cpu_seconds - time.process_time() - 0.5))
Path("packing.json").write_text(json.dumps(circles, allow_nan=False))
